reader_summary.overview: Ryan Lovell is the Director of Capital Markets at Chainlink Labs. Chainlink has powered more than $28 trillion in transaction value and powers the majority of decentralized finance. Our conversation explores the hidden plumbing of modern finance and the upgrade blockchains provide.

key_points.text: Ryan Lovell is the Director of Capital Markets at Chainlink Labs.
We discuss Chainlink's critical role in connecting traditional finance with blockchain technology, the rise of tokenization and stablecoins, institutional adoption.
